For these **Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones**, the two listings are for the *exact same product*:

* Same specs: over-ear closed back, ANC + transparency, 40hr battery with ANC on, USB-C quick charge, Bluetooth 5.3 with two-device pairing, 254g, graphite, case + USB-C + 3.5mm cable in box
* Same rating: 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews)
* Same fulfillment: In stock, Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days
* Same warranty: 1-year limited warranty

The only differences are price and returns:

**A - Brackmoor Sound:** https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/mfgchc/a
* $142.00
* Free 90-day returns. Refund to original payment method.

**B - Ottervale Audio:** https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/mfgchc/b
* $129.00
* 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. Refund to original payment method.

### Buy from A - Brackmoor Sound

You pay $13 more — about 10% more — but you get a much better return policy: **90 days vs. 30 days, and free vs. you pay for shipping.**

For over-ear headphones, that's worth it. Comfort, fit, sound signature, and noise-cancelling are very personal — you can't really know until you've worn them for a few days. With Brackmoor you get 3 months to try them with zero risk if you don't like them.

Buy from B - Ottervale Audio only if you are already 100% sure you will keep them and want the lowest upfront price of $129.
